title: Open Monument Day Berlin 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **Open Monument Day Berlin is 12 and 13 September 2026.** The citywide weekend opens many monuments that are not normally accessible.
Berlin's heritage authority expects around 350 monuments and roughly 1,000 activities, generally free but with individual access conditions.
**Book one priority visit first.** Then choose one no-registration back-up in the same district and time window.
The official programme can filter by district, Saturday or Sunday, time, theme, English-language formats, registration, indoor access and wheelchair suitability.
A beautiful building photo is not proof of a 2026 opening. Check the official detail page for date, time, registration and entry instructions.
